decision: After publishing this stage, evaluate the feasibility of a separately registered four-game model-controlled task-choice smoke with one fresh seed, both seats and a frozen task teacher control.
basis: The new fit, offline evaluation and independent aggregate review passed. The next unknown is whether the sealed model can affect a legitimate task decision and complete official games; the current eight data-collection games did not deploy it.
constraints: The model, default Bot, frozen teachers, crop model, official rules and historical results remain unchanged. Fresh seed inventory excludes known consumed and reserved identities; all checks and the total budget are frozen before execution. Do not perform DAgger, PPO, large-scale RL, online submissions or post-hoc tuning.
interpretation: A four-game smoke can establish a bounded execution path, not a statistically significant or competitive gain. If no valid intervention or fertilizer opportunity occurs, report the missing evidence rather than treating lack of a counterexample as a pass.
